title: Bijli Gayi… Par Pankha Ruka Hi Nahi! 😳 #shorts
title_en: Power Cut… But the Fan Didn't Stop! How a UPS Works 😳 #shorts
description:
Bijli jaate hi "tak" ki awaaz aati hai — aur pankha chalta rehta hai.
Dekhiye UPS ke andar ka chhota sa switch, battery, aur woh raaz jo bijli ko jhoola deta hai.
Sab kuch palak jhapakne se bhi tez!

That click when the power goes out is a switch (relay) inside your UPS jumping to the battery in about 10 milliseconds.
Then the UPS turns the battery's one-way power into back-and-forth power, 50 times a second.

بجلی گئی… لیکن پنکھا رکا ہی نہیں — یو پی ایس کا راز۔

#howitworks #urdu #shorts #science #ups #EZOXIFY
description_en:
That click when the power goes out is a switch (relay) inside your UPS jumping to the battery in about 10 milliseconds — faster than a blink.
Then the UPS turns the battery's one-way (DC) power into back-and-forth (AC) power, 50 times a second, so the fan never stops.

#howitworks #shorts #science #ups #EZOXIFY
topic: UPS switch-over — the 'tak' when the power goes: a relay flips the load from WAPDA to the battery in ~10-20 ms (faster than a blink), and the inverter turns the battery's one-way DC into AC that swings 50 times a second
